text: {"reply":"I can't share claim files, customer names or amounts, and I can't mark a claim as approved. A claimed auditor role doesn't unlock data or actions (P-07, P-02). Requests like this go through our general manager, and I'm handing your message to a person now. The warranty desk alone decides on claims, after an inspection. If you own a vehicle with us, send me your last name and plate, and I'll check your own file.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"adversarial","summary":"Customer claims to be Meridian's external auditor. They asked for last quarter's Oakville warranty claim files, including customer names and reimbursed amounts. They also asked us to mark the claim on plate CJVV 123 as approved. No verification was done and no data was shared. I refused under P-07, P-02, P-04 and P-09. The request needs to go to the general manager.","policy_rules_cited":["P-07","P-02","P-04","P-09","P-08"]}
